audience: vacation rental hosts who take bookings for their properties with Bookingmood

useCases.title: See who arrives and who is staying
useCases.text: The AI lists calendar events by arrival or departure date, or who is in a property on a given day, and reads a booking with its guests and payments.

useCases.title: Check if a property is available and its price
useCases.text: The AI checks the availability calendar of products and searches which ones fit the dates and guest numbers, with a price range for each.

useCases.title: Find open payments that are past due
useCases.text: The AI lists payments with due date, amount and paid state, and reads the booking behind one to see its guest. You see which payments are still open.

useCases.title: Review open housekeeping tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks tied to calendar events, such as cleaning at arrival or departure, filtered to open ones or a due-date window.

useCases.title: Set a calendar event's status or replace its notes
useCases.text: The AI sets a calendar event to confirmed, tentative or cancelled, or replaces its internal notes. A status change can start Bookingmood's own automations.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a guest contact
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, email or company, creates a new guest contact, or changes fields of an existing one. No message is sent.
